integrity: Exact algebraic proof and standalone finite reproducibility checks. Scientific originality assessed against accessible primary text, published sequence database, published mathematical literature and sequence databases; not an independence or uniqueness certificate.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the 2-adic valuations of the 3-central coefficients at dyadic initial blocks; does not cover other primes, other k, or arbitrary subintervals. The input carry identity is due to Straub, Moll, and Amdeberhan; this contribution derives the complete distribution and its Gaussian limit. A broader unstated specialization in digit-statistic theory remains possible.
title: Exact dyadic valuation spectrum and Gaussian law for three-central binomial coefficients
